top_comments.author: @PaulSolt
top_comments.text:
I didn't expect this to work so well. Not only did it port the C++ to Swift, but then I took it further.
I switched from the CPU software based rendering to use the GPU instead. 
This took renders from 8 seconds down to 300ms while boosting the resolution from low to 4K!
